name: QuickBuster (Async Directory & Endpoint Fuzzer)
author: itsmhmiri
description: High-speed asynchronous HTTP directory and endpoint discovery tool with smart 404 calibration that eliminates wildcard false positives.

parameters.name: url
parameters.label: Target Base URL
parameters.description: Base HTTP/HTTPS URL of the target web application

parameters.name: wordlist
parameters.label: Wordlist Preset
parameters.description: Wordlist file containing endpoints and route paths

parameters.name: calibrate
parameters.label: Smart 404 Calibration
parameters.description: Send probe requests to fingerprint custom or wildcard 404 pages

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.label: Extensions (optional)
parameters.description: Comma-separated extensions to append to path probes

parameters.name: status_codes
parameters.label: Status Codes to Report
parameters.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes to consider valid findings
